name: TexObj_InitFromHeader
summary: Fills a texture object descriptor from an image header: copies 16-byte name, width/height/bpp, palette and pixel pointers, flags 'cubemap ' textures, and tags DXT-style formats when the device supports them.
evidence: Name compare to 'cube'+'map ' sets type bits at +44; switch on bpp 4/8/16/24/32 with palette sizes 16/256 entries; compares a 4-byte code against tables dword_103511CC/E0 gated by g_pCDx caps bytes; caller sub_10026890 (CYyIcon ctor) passes a freshly built TexObj.

name: Tex_DrawNamedTexturePreview
summary: Looks up a texture by its 16-char name in g_pTextureMng, binds it to stage 0 and draws it as a 256x256 screen quad at (x, y+16).
evidence: TexMgr_FindByName(g_pTextureMng, name...), SetTexture(0, tex+64 or tex+68), then sub_1001DD00(a1, a2+16.0); no callers (debug path).

name: Gfx_DrawScreenQuad256
summary: Draws a 256x256 pre-transformed textured quad at (x,y) with Z and alpha test disabled, then restores them.
evidence: Builds 4 verts x 28 bytes with +256.0 offsets; FVF 324 (XYZRHW|DIFFUSE|TEX1), DrawPrimitiveUP(TRIANGLESTRIP, 2); ZENABLE/ALPHATESTENABLE 0 then 1; point filtering, clamp addressing, COLOROP SELECTARG1.

name: Tex_HeightToNormalMap
summary: Converts an 8-bit heightmap into a packed normal map using Sobel-style neighbour gradients with wrap-around, writing one 32-bit texel per pixel.
evidence: Wrap masks (width*height-1, width-1), gradient sums 2*(a-b)+..., normalise via 127/sqrt(gx^2+gy^2+65025), +128 bias, packed into DWORD; caller TexObj_Upload; width/height read from this+52/+54.

name: CYyCamMng2_CreateGlobal
summary: Allocates and constructs a 280-byte object, stores it in global dword_10456D6C, initialises it and returns the result of sub_10015100 on it.
evidence: sub_1002C890(280) -> sub_1001E600 ctor -> dword_10456D6C; sub_1001E590 init; unit CYyCamMng2; 4 callers.

name: CYyCamMng2_CallGlobalVfunc1
summary: If the global object dword_10456D6C exists, calls its vtable slot 1 with &unk_10351224.
evidence: Single null check then (*vtbl+4)(obj, &unk_10351224); same global created by sub_1001E470.

name: Actor_GetPercentScaleByIndex
summary: Returns byte this[10+idx] (idx<4, else asserts and uses 0) as a percentage scale factor: 0xFF means 1.0, otherwise value*0.01.
evidence: idx>=4 -> nullsub_12 assert stub; 0xFF -> 1.0; *0.0099999998; callers CXiSkeletonActor_SetModel, sub_100CF750.

name: Actor_LookupPercentScaleA
summary: Looks up an entry via sub_10022170 and returns its signed byte at +10 times 0.01, or 1.0 if not found.
evidence: sub_10022170 returns index (<0 means missing -> 1.0); (char)entry[+10]*0.01; callers CXiSkeletonActor_SetModel, sub_100CF750; twin of sub_100221E0 (+11).

name: Actor_LookupPercentScaleB
summary: Looks up an entry via sub_10022170 and returns its signed byte at +11 times 0.01, or 1.0 if not found.
evidence: Same shape as sub_10022190 but field +11; same callers.

name: Actor_InitIndexTable
summary: Runs base init sub_100220E0 then fills byte slots +16..+19, +20..+35 and +36..+37 with 0xFF (unset) and returns this.
evidence: Only stores of -1 bytes after base init; called from all CXiSkeletonActor_Constructor_* variants.

name: Actor_SetPair14
summary: Stores two dwords from a2 into this+0x14 and this+0x18.

name: Actor_SetPair1C
summary: Stores two dwords from a2 into this+0x1C and this+0x20.

summary: Looks up an entry via sub_10022320 and returns its byte at +28, or 0 if not found or 0xFF.

name: CYyModelDt_SetVertexShader
summary: Caches a vertex shader/FVF handle in g_vertexShader_6E4C and sets it on the device when non-zero.
evidence: g_vertexShader_6E4C = a1; SetVertexShader(device, a1) if a1 != 0; caller CYyModelDt_PrepareRenderState.

name: CYyModelDt_ExpandTriList
summary: Expands a list of indexed triangles (15-word records: 3 vertex indices + per-corner UVs) into a 32-byte-stride vertex array, returning the vertex count; skipped when flag bit +52&1 is set.
evidence: Per triangle: sub_10022FD0 copies vertex by index then two UV dwords per corner; output advances 24 dwords (3 x 32 bytes); count += 3; caller CYyModelDt_PrepareRenderState.

name: CYyModelDt_ExpandTriStrip
summary: Expands an indexed strip (first triangle with 3 corners, then one new vertex+UV per 5-word record) into a 32-byte-stride vertex array, returning the vertex count.
evidence: First record yields 3 verts (v8=3), subsequent records add 1 vert each; uses sub_10022FD0 vertex copy; caller CYyModelDt_PrepareRenderState.

name: CYyModelDt_Destructor
summary: Destructor: stores CYyModelDt vtable, frees the buffer at +0x40, then runs the base destructor sub_10029CD0.
evidence: *this = CYyModelDt_vtbl_ambiguous0; sub_10028700 (tagged free) on this[16]; tail-calls sub_10029CD0; caller CYyModelDt_VT_1032A430_ScalarDeletingDtor.

name: ProjTex_Destructor
summary: Destructor for the projected-texture helper (vtable off_1032A460): releases the COM texture at +4 and surface at +8.
evidence: *this = off_1032A460; vtbl+8 (IUnknown::Release) on this[1], this[2]; called from CYyModel dtor sub_1002B550 for member at +0x90 and from a scalar deleting dtor.

name: ProjTex_BeginPass
summary: Sets up an additive projected-texture pass: binds the helper's texture, saves the material textures and colour, and generates stage-0 coords from camera-space position through the supplied matrix.
evidence: SetTransform(D3DTS_TEXTURE0, a4); TEXTURETRANSFORMFLAGS 0x104 (COUNT4|PROJECTED); TEXCOORDINDEX 0x20000 (CAMERASPACEPOSITION); SRCBLEND SRCALPHA, DESTBLEND ONE; ZWRITE off; saves a2[0..1] in dword_10456E58/5C, a3 in E68; caller sub_1002DC10.

name: ProjTex_EndPass
summary: Restores the normal material pass after the projected-texture pass: rebinds the saved base textures to stages 0/1 and resets blend, Z write, addressing, texgen and the stage-1 combiner.
evidence: Rebinds dword_10456E58/5C via TexObj_GetD3DTexture; ALPHABLEND off, ALPHAFUNC GREATER, ZWRITE on, TEXCOORDINDEX 0, TTFF 0; stage1 MODULATE2X or MODULATEALPHA_ADDCOLOR depending on a1; TEXTUREFACTOR from E68; paired with sub_10025330.

name: TexObj_GetD3DTexture
summary: Returns the D3D texture at +0x40, or the fallback one at +0x44 if the first is null.
evidence: return this[16] ? this[16] : this[17]; same +64/+68 pattern used before SetTexture in sub_1001DC70 and sub_10026990.

name: ProjTex_CaptureToTarget
summary: Stores the projection parameters in globals and copies a source texture into the helper's own render target with a full-target screen quad.
evidence: CDx_PushRenderTarget(this[1], this[2]); quad sized from CDx_GetRenderTargetTop width/height; SetTexture(0, a2); FVF 324 TRIANGLESTRIP; Z/alpha test off then restored; caller sub_1002B6E0 (model draw) passes g_pCDx texture at _pad_10[388].

name: EnvMap_BeginPass
summary: Sets up an additive environment-map pass: binds the global env texture, saves base textures, and generates stage-0 coords from camera-space normals through a 2D texture matrix.
evidence: TEXCOORDINDEX 0x10000 (CAMERASPACENORMAL), TTFF COUNT2, SetTransform(TEXTURE0); WRAP0=7 unless flags; LIGHTING off; SRCBLEND SRCALPHA/DESTBLEND ONE; uses dword_10456E88 and TFACTOR dword_10456E8C; caller sub_1002DC10.

name: EnvMap_EndPass
summary: Restores the normal material pass after the environment-map pass: rebinds saved textures, re-enables lighting and Z write, clears WRAP0, blend and texgen.
evidence: Rebinds dword_10456E80/84 via TexObj_GetD3DTexture; LIGHTING 1, WRAP0 0, ALPHABLEND 0, TCI 0; same stage-1 combiner branch as sub_100255C0; TFACTOR dword_10456E7C.

name: Dbg_DrawGroundGrid
summary: Draws a 17x17 line grid spanning -8..8 on the XZ plane with an identity world transform.

name: Dbg_DrawAxesAt
summary: Draws red/green/blue unit X/Y/Z axis lines at the given world position, then restores the world matrix.
evidence: Identity + translation from a1 set as WORLD; three LINELIST draws with colours 0x80800000/0x80008000/0x80000080; FVF 66; restores saved WORLD.

name: CYyIcon_Constructor

name: CYyIcon_Draw
summary: Draws the icon's texture as a screen quad at (x,y) sized to the texture with the given colour, optionally with alpha blending.
